relation_to_rt017_v1: RT017 V1 remains BLOCKED and is not rewritten. V2 is an additional adversarial test because V1 produced no market verdict; its fixed ±20% matching rule had insufficient control availability.

method.event_prevol: Population standard deviation of 15m log-close returns in the 24h strictly before the event entry.
method.control_pool: Same YYYY-MM and same UTC entry quarter-hour; exclude actual date ±1 UTC day; require complete pre24h and post24h windows.
method.matching: Exactly five controls with smallest absolute prevol difference; deterministic timestamp tie-break.
method.overlap: Reject/redraw portfolios with overlapping 24h post windows inside a historical block.
